decisions.reason: The client explicitly requires the connectors not to obstruct the mounting holes, adding a mounting-access constraint to the board's form-factor and mounting requirements.

source_message.text: yes, that is perfect as long as it can fit (not covering holes and at least some small space between them)

decisions.reason: Connector spacing and mounting-hole clearance do not change the battery NTC connection or thermal-protection behavior.
The mechanical connector-placement decision does not change the battery electrical-protection controller or cutoff rules.
The source decision does not alter the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated-LED requirement.
Physical clearance around connectors does not change the selected USB-C interface, part, compatibility, or sourceability requirements.
The connector-layout constraint does not affect the addressable-LED family or data GPIO.
The source decision does not change the 5V boost converter, enable control, default state, or powered loads.
Mounting-hole and adjacent-connector clearance do not alter the I2C cable, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location requirements.
